camel_example: aliyun agentcore PUT /workspaces/ws-2f5f9c5a8d0e4c3b/memorystores/customer-memory/memories/mem-2f5f9c5a8d0e4c3b --region cn-hangzhou --header "Content-Type=application/x-www-form-urlencoded" --body 'body={metadata={key=hiking}, text=用户喜欢在周末徒步旅行。}' --version 2026-08-04 --force
description_en: Updates the content or metadata of a specified memory. At least one field must be provided for the update, and unprovided fields retain their original values. The metadata is fully replaced. Pass an empty object to clear the metadata
description_zh: 更新指定记忆的正文或元数据。至少提供一个更新字段；未提供的字段保持原值。metadata 为完整替换，传入空对象可清空元数据
kebab_example: aliyun agentcore update-memory --workspace-id ws-2f5f9c5a8d0e4c3b --memory-store-name customer-memory --memory-id mem-2f5f9c5a8d0e4c3b --biz-body '{"metadata":{"key":"hiking"},"text":"用户喜欢在周末徒步旅行。"}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateMemory

parameters.help_en: The name of the memory store
parameters.name: memory_store_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the long-term memory
parameters.name: memory_id

fields.help_en: The updated string key-value metadata. Provide at least one of Text or Metadata. A maximum of 16 keys are allowed. The maximum length is 64 characters for a key and 1,024 characters for a value
fields.help_zh: 更新后的字符串键值元数据；与 Text 至少提供一个，最多 16 个键，键最长 64 字符，值最长 1024 字符
fields.name: metadata

fields.example: 用户喜欢在周末徒步旅行。
fields.help_en: The updated memory text. Provide at least one of Text or Metadata. The size cannot exceed 32,000 UTF-8 bytes
fields.help_zh: 更新后的记忆文本；与 Metadata 至少提供一个，不超过 32000 UTF-8 字节
fields.name: text

parameters.help_en: The request to update a memory
parameters.name: body

createdAt.description_en: The creation time. The time is in RFC 3339 format. The Z at the end of the example indicates the UTC time zone
createdAt.description_zh: 创建时间。采用 RFC 3339 格式；示例末尾的 Z 表示 UTC 时区

memoryId.description_en: The ID of the long-term memory

agentId.description_en: The agent ID. The length is limited to 1 to 128 UTF-8 bytes. The ID cannot contain a forward slash (/) or an asterisk (*). This field is not returned if the memory is not associated with an agent ID
agentId.description_zh: Agent ID，长度限制 1 - 128 UTF-8 字节，不允许包含 / 或使用 *；记忆未关联 Agent ID 时此字段不返回

sessionId.description_en: The session ID. The length is limited to 1 to 128 UTF-8 bytes. The ID cannot contain a forward slash (/) or an asterisk (*). This field is not returned if the memory is not associated with a session ID
sessionId.description_zh: Session ID，长度限制 1 - 128 UTF-8 字节，不允许包含 / 或使用 *；记忆未关联 Session ID 时此字段不返回

teamId.description_en: The business team ID defined by the caller. It cannot be empty when provided and can be up to 128 UTF-8 bytes in length
teamId.description_zh: 由调用方定义的业务团队标识。提供时不能为空，最多 128 个 UTF-8 字节

userId.description_en: The user ID. The length is limited to 1 to 128 UTF-8 bytes. The ID cannot contain a forward slash (/) or an asterisk (*). This field is not returned if the memory is not associated with a user ID
userId.description_zh: 用户 ID，长度限制 1 - 128 UTF-8 字节，不允许包含 / 或使用 *；记忆未关联用户 ID 时此字段不返回

source.description_en: The memory source. Valid values: session_extraction: Extracted from session events. content_extraction: Extracted from text or messages. direct: Written directly
source.description_zh: 记忆来源：session_extraction 表示从会话事件提取，content_extraction 表示从文本或消息提取，direct 表示直接写入

type.description_en: The memory content type. Valid values: semantic: Semantic memory. skill: Skill. user_profile: User preference. session_summary: Session summary
type.description_zh: 记忆内容类型：semantic 为语义记忆，skill 为技能，user_profile 为用户偏好，session_summary 为会话摘要

updatedAt.description_en: The last updated time. The time is in RFC 3339 format. The Z at the end of the example indicates the UTC time zone
updatedAt.description_zh: 最后更新时间。采用 RFC 3339 格式；示例末尾的 Z 表示 UTC 时区

valid.description_en: Indicates whether the memory is valid. A value of false indicates that the memory is revoked and is not included in valid memory retrieval
valid.description_zh: 记忆是否有效。false 表示已撤销，不参与有效记忆检索

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
